restroom_02_basins.title: Two washbasins
restroom_02_basins.speaker: protagonist
restroom_02_basins.text: Both taps are wound shut. Scale rings the strainers; one bright clip bridges the mirror seam. Brown streaks hang below the pipe over the urinals.
restroom_02_basins.repeat_text: Shut taps, scaled strainers, and one bright clip.

restroom_02_latch.title: Second cubicle
restroom_02_latch.speaker: protagonist
restroom_02_latch.text: The indicator shows a narrow band of red. The end of the bolt is visible through a gap in the plate. From here you cannot see what is keeping it there.
restroom_02_latch.repeat_text: A sliver of red and the end of the bolt.

restroom_02_drain.title: Floor grate
restroom_02_drain.speaker: protagonist
restroom_02_drain.text: Water collects around the grate but has not spread past the repaired tile. Several flies stay close to the floor.
restroom_02_drain.repeat_text: A little warmer tile at the edge of the grate.
